prompt: Orthographic isometric 3D render, ultra clean, of a cryptographic threshold-signing mechanism for institutional custody. Three large interlocking rings of brushed titanium float around a smoked glass vault core above a dark obsidian floor (#07090E) etched with a faint fine grid. Each ring carries several small glass key segments; most glow soft emerald, two glow warm gold, one is dark and empty. A second, smaller set of rings sits inside the first, showing two layers of approval. Frosted glass plates with soft refraction, polished chamfers, a warm gold key light from the upper right, deep shadows, large calm dark negative space on the left third of the frame. Precise, minimal, expensive. No text, no numbers, no logos, no people.
